findings.rule: b ^ ((a ^ b) * c) with c in {0, 1} is 'a if c else b'; with c = (a < b) it is min(a, b), with c = (a > b) max(a, b) (also with the operands of ^ swapped).

notes: No explicit loops in the source (functions and libraries reached). All 33 whiles are the bytes32[] decodes of Morpho extSloads (P7). Long functions (borrow, deposit, withdraw, skim, repay, liquidate, handleExternalLiquidation, checkVaultStatus, setTwyneLiqLTV, initialize) reviewed by structure: auth/pause/reentrancy checks (stor9B77 == 2 is the ERC-7201 ReentrancyGuard), external calls, transient snapshot writes (transient[0..8]), storage writes and events. P1: the OZ Initializable ERC-7201 slot printed as 'stor[0x111f...aa0 * 3600]' beside its named form storF0C5_64 in the same line (420-421). P9 counts lines with '-1 *' / '-10000 *' distributed factors. No semantic error found on the paths read.
summary: Complete and faithful on the paths read, but the LTV arithmetic is close to unreadable: OZ branchless min/max/ternary printed as XOR expressions (205 lines) inside distributed products and ceilDivs, plus P7 decode loops and raw-memory call arguments.
